# emerging.tools

> Discovery index for LLM and AI assistant retrieval.

Site: https://emerging.tools
Primary language: en
Scope: Trending VS Code themes and developer fonts, ranked by momentum.

## Canonical URLs
- https://emerging.tools/
- https://emerging.tools/sitemap.xml
- https://emerging.tools/robots.txt

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://emerging.tools/): Main ranked feed of emerging VS Code themes under 150K installs.
- [Theme Detail Pages](https://emerging.tools/themes/): Per-theme pages with metadata, color palettes, ratings, and install context.

## Data Freshness
- Theme snapshot: `data/latest.json`
- Font snapshot: `data/fonts-latest.json`
- Sync endpoint: `GET /api/sync` (auth optional via `SYNC_SECRET`)

## Entity
- Name: emerging.tools
- Type: Website / Tool discovery index
- Area served: Worldwide
